summary: When read_exact requests more bytes than remain, buf-list returns UnexpectedEof without updating the cursor position, diverging from std::io::Cursor on Rust 1.80 and later. The fix sets the position to the buffer's total length before returning the error. The existing cursor operation property test compares positions against std::io::Cursor after each operation; the fix adds a saved regression seed in proptest-regressions/cursor/tests.txt. This is a proposed comparison, not an observed reproduction.
